numerical_claims.source_value: 190.9 thousand travellers (2025), 239.5 thousand travellers (2024), 20.3% decrease, EUR 168,483 thousand revenue (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword and Main ratios table confirm traveller numbers and revenue figures. EUR 168.5 million is correct rounding of EUR 168,483 thousand.

numerical_claims.claim: Gross profit decreased 5.3% to EUR 19.7 million, but the gross profit margin improved from 10.33% to 11.66%, indicating better profitability on the reduced sales base.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 19,650 thousand gross profit (2025, -5.3% vs 2024), 11.66% gross profit margin (2025 vs 10.33% in 2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Main ratios table provides exact figures: Gross profit EUR 19,650 thousand (2025) vs EUR 20,742 thousand (2024) = -5.3% change. Gross profit margin 11.66% (2025) vs 10.33% (2024).

numerical_claims.claim: Adjusted EBITDA rose to EUR 420 thousand from negative EUR 449 thousand, and EBITDA increased from a EUR 6.1 million loss to positive EUR 420 thousand.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 420 thousand Adjusted EBITDA (2025), EUR -449 thousand Adjusted EBITDA (2024), EUR 420 thousand EBITDA (2025), EUR -6,132 thousand EBITDA (2024)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Main ratios table shows exact values: 12M 2025 Adjusted EBITDA EUR 420 thousand, 12M 2024 Adjusted EBITDA EUR -449 thousand; 12M 2025 EBITDA EUR 420 thousand, 12M 2024 EBITDA EUR -6,132 thousand.

numerical_claims.claim: Operating loss narrowed from EUR 6.6 million to EUR 274 thousand.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR -6,556 thousand operating profit (2024), EUR -274 thousand operating profit (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Main ratios table: 12M 2024 Operating profit EUR -6,556 thousand, 12M 2025 Operating profit EUR -274 thousand.

numerical_claims.claim: The net loss decreased 84.6%, from EUR 7.6 million to EUR 1.2 million; excluding the EUR 5.7 million non-cash goodwill impairment recorded in 2024, the report states that the annual net loss decreased by 39%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR -7,604 thousand net profit (2024), EUR -1,169 thousand net profit (2025), EUR 5.7 million goodwill impairment in 2024
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Main ratios table: 12M 2024 Net profit EUR -7,604 thousand, 12M 2025 Net profit EUR -1,169 thousand. CEO’s Foreword explicitly states the 39% decrease exclusion of EUR 5.7 million goodwill impairment.

numerical_claims.claim: Earnings per share improved from negative EUR 0.97 to negative EUR 0.15.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Main ratios table: Earnings per share (EPS) for 12M 2024 EUR -0.97, 12M 2025 EUR -0.15.

numerical_claims.claim: EBITDA margin and net margin improved by 3.3 and 3.1 percentage points, respectively, although the Group remained loss-making.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EBITDA margin improved from -3.05% (2024) to 0.25% (2025) = +3.3 pp; Net margin improved from -3.79% (2024) to -0.69% (2025) = +3.1 pp
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Alternative measures table provides exact margin percentages: EBITDA margin 0.25% (2025) vs -3.05% (2024); Net profit margin -0.69% (2025) vs -3.79% (2024).

numerical_claims.claim: Flight package tours, the core segment, generated EUR 145.1 million in sales, down 15.0%, but segment sales profit increased 18.0% to EUR 12.2 million and its margin rose to 8%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 145,120 thousand sales (2025), EUR 12,162 thousand sales profit (2025), 8% sales profit margin (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Segment information table: Flight package tours 12M 2025 Sales EUR 145,120 thousand (-15.0% vs 2024), Sales profit EUR 12,162 thousand (+18.0% vs 2024), Sales profit margin 8%.

numerical_claims.claim: Conversely, sightseeing tours by plane generated substantially lower segment profit, while other sales remained loss-making, with a EUR 2.5 million segment loss.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 135 thousand segment profit for sightseeing tours by plane (2025 vs EUR 864 thousand in 2024); EUR -2,515 thousand segment profit for other sales (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Segment information table: 12M 2025 Sightseeing tours by plane Sales profit EUR 135 thousand (vs EUR 864 thousand in 2024). Other sales Sales profit EUR -2,515 thousand.

numerical_claims.claim: The Group ended the year with EUR 1.7 million in cash, up from EUR 394 thousand, supported by positive financing cash flow and EUR 4.5 million of new loans.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 1,691 thousand cash and cash equivalents (2025), EUR 394 thousand (2024), EUR 4,500 thousand loans received in financing activities
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of cash flow: Cash and cash equivalents at period end EUR 1,691 thousand (vs EUR 394 thousand in 2024). Financing activities show loans received EUR 4,500 thousand.

numerical_claims.claim: However, borrowings increased to EUR 12.9 million, equity declined to EUR 6.9 million, and the debt-to-equity ratio rose to 191.42%.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 12,867 thousand total borrowings (2025), EUR 6,863 thousand total equity (2025), 191.42% debt-to-equity ratio (2025)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated statements of financial position: Total borrowings EUR 12,867 thousand, Total equity EUR 6,863 thousand, Debt/equity ratio 191.42% as of 31 December 2025.

numerical_claims.claim: Early bookings for summer 2026 were 59% higher by December 2025, supporting management’s plan for a similar or slightly larger programme focused on continued efficiency and profitability growth.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: 59% increase in early bookings for 2026 summer season by December 2025
numerical_claims.source_evidence: CEO’s Foreword: 'By December 2025, bookings for the 2026 summer season were 59 percent higher than in the previous year... For 2026, we currently plan our travel programme at a similar or slightly higher level... to continue delivering consistent profitability growth.'

numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: One of the key efficiency indicators, aircraft load factor, increased by 1.5 percentage points in 2025 to 97.2 percent, compared with 95.7 percent in 2024.
